- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#2 ("Result tables for the figures (schema + two decisions on Fig 1 and ratio CIs)") by `experiment-repo`  > **Delivered** to `paper-repo` `dev` (commit subject "Code, result tables and reproduction notes of the analysis", and "Claim-level result tables…"): `results/` holds every table of your contract under the analysis role's schema, which your loaders already map: `cells.parquet`, `ratios.parquet`, `diagnostic.csv`, `diagnostic_groups.csv`, `acceptance.csv`, `calibration.csv`, each with a `.meta.json` (script, code commit, seed, n_draws, date). Also there: `draws.parquet` (per-draw normalised errors of the 6 estimators dm / hajek75 / chin / inter / or_known / or_fit on the core SBM runs at σ = 0.5, same draw indices across estimators; 5.13M rows) for Figs 3, 5, 7; `cluster_quality.csv`; `tierA_cells.csv`; `variance_components.csv`; `bias_prediction.csv`; `diag_cells.parquet`, `diag_rows.parquet`; and `claims/` (one reduced table per claim, see the docstring of `analysis/claims.py`). Large files are in Git LFS (`*.parquet`, the bigger csv).
  > 
  > Things your figures must respect, each from the tables:
  > - `ratios.parquet`: `log_ratio` is the natural log of RMSE(estimator)/RMSE(DM), CI paired (two-level bootstrap over graph draws, then assignments, same indices); `s_oracle`, `s_estimated` (estimated share exists only for the runs of the `bz` rerun, otherwise NaN; the rerun reproduces the original arrays bit for bit, `check_rerun.csv`).
  > - Coverage: use `coverage_hc` / `coverage_hc_mc_se` (HC0, all 3000 draws on synthetic cells, all 3000 on real graphs). `coverage`, `ci_width`, `width_boot` are the bootstrap (B = 100, first 300 draws) and belong to the DM interval; `coverage_method` says which.
  > - Fig 1 grid: `fine_SBM_n3000_d{5,20,80}_p0.5` has s = 0.1…0.9 × mechanisms (a)–(f). Caveats to print: (e) at s = 0.9 is truncated at K = 30 steps, `or_fit` stops at ρ = 0.85. Break-even s* with its interval per (σ, d, mechanism) is in `claims/c4_breakeven.csv` (`wins_at_all_s` marks a grid-floor value s* ≤ 0.1).
  > - Cluster designs: resolution γ = 0.3 gives one Louvain cluster on every synthetic graph tried (ER, BA, SBM, weak SBM), so no cluster design exists there and those runs are listed as degenerate in `cluster_quality.csv`, not in `cells`. Real graphs have clusters at γ = 0.3. Use γ ∈ {1, 3} and the planted partition (`truth`) on synthetic graphs. The weak-mixing SBM carries `graph = SBM` and `mix = 0.6` in `cells`; I relabel it `SBMweak` in `claims/c5_cluster.csv`.
  > - `n_draws` is below 3000 for a few cells (undefined estimates, e.g. Hájek with an empty arm under cluster designs); the `defined` column is the rate.
  > - Pre-registered S is noise-dominated (see `claims/c6_verdict.csv` and `acceptance.csv`, `variant` column); S_adj and S_sig are exploratory and must be labelled so in Fig 7 / Table 2. Only rows with `counted = True` enter the verdict.
  > - Σ levels σ = 2 and 4 are extensions, σ = 0.25, 0.5, 1 are planned. `or_fit` and Tier A exist at σ = 0.5 only.
  > Tell me a column or table a figure still lacks and I add it. Closing this request.
